claim: DOE's public Order 202-26-50 docket now exposes PJM Exhibit A Version 3, submitted October 13, 2026 at 3:15 PM ET. Relative to Version 2, Version 3 appends a backup-resource list with a stated total of 2,175.924 MW and multiple explicit emergency-only/pre-emergency ineligibility limitations. Listing expands the documented option set; it does not establish independent reachability, present availability, dispatch, operation, delivered MW, customer migration, or avoided consequences.

source.title: DOE Order 202-26-50 docket entry: PJM 202(c) Updated Exhibit A as of October 13 at 3:15 PM ET
Exhibit A – Specified Resources (VERSION 3 – submitted October 13, 2026)

falsifier: A corrected authoritative filing or reproducible Version 2-to-Version 3 comparison showing that the appended backup-resource section or its stated 2,175.924 MW total is not new, or that the aggregate has been misread.
firstUnsupportedArrow: listed in Exhibit A → independently reachable and presently available → PJM issued an applicable backup-generator instruction → recipient received and acted → unit started and legally interconnected → usable MW reached the grid/load → downstream consequence was avoided
omissions: No complete facility-by-facility Version 2-to-Version 3 reconciliation or independently reproduced row count.
No Emergency Use of Backup Generator Warning or Action was retrieved with this filing.
EEA1 is not EEA3; the governing order treats backup generation as a last-resort pathway before EEA3 or during EEA3.
Many entries state 'Emergency only' and that they cannot participate as pre-emergency assets.
No evidence of fuel, start success, telemetry, transfer-switch or grid-parallel capability, delivered output, recipient acknowledgement, cost allocation, or permit compliance.
The 2,175.924 MW figure is the filing's stated aggregate for the appended backup-resource list, not the full Exhibit A total and not verified available capacity.
The list includes varied facilities; inclusion does not establish a data-center-specific event, customer migration, or restored capacity.
rivalHypotheses: PJM assembled a genuinely reachable set of emergency-only assets for last-resort operation.
The list is precautionary legal inventory and many listed units will never be called.
A material share of stated MW may be administratively eligible yet physically unavailable, fuel-limited, island-only, or unable to parallel with the grid.

EDC/transmission operators for routing and operational coordination
facility/resource owners for physical execution, fuel, and permit compliance
